readout_other: TMS MEP amplitude, SICI, ICF, resting motor threshold in FDI, APB and ADM
direction_notes: No significant effect of 5 Hz-rTUS versus sham on MEP amplitude, SICI, ICF or rMT; post-hoc simulations showed the focus was outside the M1 hand area in most participants.
safety_notes: None of the participants reported discomfort or adverse effects; simulated mechanical index about 0.26 and maximum temperature rise about 0.22 C.
